title: Play: when, then how much, by strict rules (#89)

screens.title: 1 · When, nothing running
screens.why: Play always asks when, even with Agora free.

pins.label: Nothing runs
pins.text: The line under the title says so, and the task's length.

pins.label: Começar agora
pins.text: The accent. Hidden when now has under 20 min of room before the next fixed block (rule 3); the later hour becomes the accent.

pins.label: Daqui a 15 min · 10:15
pins.text: Anchors it 15 min from now. When that hour has under 20 min of room it reads 'Às 13:00', the first hour that has.

screens.title: 2 · When, something running
screens.why: Now, or right after what runs, at the next hour with room.

pins.label: What runs
pins.text: Its name and its end, so the person knows what 'now' interrupts.

pins.label: Começar agora
pins.text: Leads to the pause question (3), then how much (4).

pins.label: Depois de … · 10:38
pins.text: First in Em seguida, at the first hour after it with ≥ 20 min of room, whether or not the whole fits. Not offered when the task is already next.

screens.title: 3 · Pause what runs?
screens.why: The guard is now a yes or no, and Pendentes' sums stay true.

pins.label: One question
pins.text: Replaces Concluir / Pausar em Pendentes / Para depois: after 'now', pausing is the only road.

pins.label: The split
pins.text: The running task becomes two subtasks: the 12 min done (ticked off) and the 33 min left, waiting in Pendentes.

pins.label: Sim / Não
pins.text: Não changes nothing. A drop on Agora while something runs asks the same.

screens.title: 4 · How much, over an hour
screens.why: Measured against the room at the chosen hour.

pins.label: The room
pins.text: From the chosen hour to the next fixed block or the day's end: 1h55 until the Standup.

pins.label: 30 min · 1h
pins.text: Always offered over an hour; 30 min the accent, as today.

pins.label: The most
pins.text: 'Tudo · 4h' when it fits, else all the room (1h55). Under an hour of room, only that room.

screens.title: 5 · An hour or less that doesn't fit
screens.why: One button: the room there is.

pins.label: Só cabem 20 min
pins.text: A task of 1h or less that fits asks nothing at all.

pins.label: Fazer 20 min
pins.text: The piece becomes a subtask at 11:35; the 40 min left, another, where the task was.
